_meta.purpose: Bounded colour sets for recipe channels. `emissive` is THE set out.emissive may take (the material-budget invariant, B46FFC37): the Sablework bench writes an entry VERBATIM into the recipe and snaps Roll's random glow to the nearest entry. This keeps emissive variants bounded and lets emissive colours align with a small palette rather than a full RGB space.
_meta.set: The curated plastic set (Aaron, ruled 2026-08-19, D6 of ruling BC95B08F): core red/green/blue, secondary magenta/cyan/white, extended orange/violet. BLACK IS EXCLUDED by that ruling - black is the absence of light, not a light colour; never add it here. Supersedes the interim EGA-16 set.
_meta.space: Values are the recipe's native colour domain — map byte / 255, written verbatim to out.emissive and into the swatch styles, with NO linear<->sRGB conversion (the same convention every shipped ramp stop and the rolled hsv() glow already use).
_meta.order: Array index IS the identity: swatch order, nav order, and the pick index are all this array's position. Appending grows the set with no code change. NOTE: because Roll snaps to the nearest entry, re-rolling the SAME seed after editing this file can land on a different colour — saved recipes are immune (they store the snapped value).
